# PART 4 – Robustness {#part-4-robustness .darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 4
:::

::: notes
The reproductions showed that the number of each analyst follows from the choices that the analyst made, and in this last part you make the choices yourself. We open the menu of decisions that every analyst of this claim faces, you work through it one decision at a time, and you send the analysis that you would defend to the class chart. We then read that chart against every justifiable analysis of the claim on these data, you declare one analysis before you run it, and at the end you run it again on the data of the new experiment with which SCORE tested the claim.
:::
